content: Babior We Ye Budoh Mo Irel

Babior le ila ye budoh mo irel Jude le iy lol Jesus Kristus boy ngo iy bisil James le yal — Ngalir rechokla Deus sa ffesangur le re mel luwul hachangcheng la yael Deus le Temach ngo Jesus Kristus ye kekafalir:
Fahol ladep, mo hopos, mo hachangcheng be mel iremi le tor siyal.
Sensey Kala Rete Katos

Hami rewol maryarey le ihachangugmi, iyedamgili le ibe teftaf wey babior iremi bo ibe kangalugmi kofael yalapel molow le yach pangach loh. Iwe ngo isa luwaley loh chog le ibe teftaf wey babior iremi ibe kangalugmi bo habe yedamgel bo habe mel chog irel tugul we Deus ye fang ngalir mekla lol le towe yoh le yebe liwel.

Bo yor tot yarmat le rete hafali loh Deus, le si tugla chog ngo resa mel luwuluch. Resa wilgi loh kaptael haradiya la yael Deus bo yagel mala be yor kofael wegdeg tayikof kala re foforu. Re tolpagili loh Jesus Kristus le iy chog mele yach Masta ngo yach Samol. Muswe chog ngo Babior we ye Santus ye faesu sor kofael hagerger le yesa holar.
Ila mwo ha gola pangal meka ngo idipli bo ibe hamangi ngalugmi wululul yael Samol hadorar re Israel mo woal Egypt, ngo yela wol miril ngo yesa llir loh rechokwe rete chepar.

Habe luluwaley chog angelus kowe rete mel chog irel lisiyal molwe keler we Deus ye fang ngalir, ngo re ligda loh loboswe Deus ye yitlir iyang. Ir ila resa chen le tor siyal mo lobosla ye ruchupung mo falulol. Ila lobosla Deus yesa yitlir iyang bo rebe widi Ral la yebe fang yar hagerger.

Ha luluwaley chog Sodom mo Gomorrah, mo haplom kowe ye harpar we mokwe yarmetal re foru chog tapel mokwe angelus kowe re foru. Ngo re foru mekla wegdigil maltemay. Ir ila resa hafohoy irel yaef la tor siyal, le ila mele yar hagerger bo yarmat rebe dap irel meka.
Iye sengal chog yar rechoka luluwal iwe resa foru molfid ka ye tayikof ngal holngor. Iwe ngo re tolpagili loh mala kelel Deus, ngo re hapatpat tayikof loh irel mekla ye mel wol laeng.

Michael mwo, we iy tamol angelus ngo yete foru mele. Irel yar hachocho fengal mo Moniyan we hare itey semal ir le yebe hasi molwe porgol Moses, ngo Michael yete tayikof yal hapatpat irel yal hatugulu yael Moniyan we hagerger. Ngo ligdi bo ye sor bo, “Samol yebe fang yam hagerger!”
Iwe ngo rechoka ila rema hapatpat tayikof irel mekla re togla fal. Iwe ngo yesa wochog bo ir mael, le mekla re faesul gola le re foforu ila ikla mele yebe hatayikofar.

Yebe kel yar hafohoy. Resa dabey molwe yalapal Cain. Fael salapiy mele resa dabey tapel molwe Balaam ye foru we ye tabung. Ir re hapaliyel le ye wochog molwe Korah ye foru, ila rebe mes le rebe tapilil chog Korah.

Resa wochog meka ye bbol le re mel luwulumi irel yodka hama rol ttey fengal habe mongoy. Rema luluwaley chog mmalel lufulyer. Re wochog madpil darmiy ka yaeng ma yugu loh le yete ma potogdiy. Re wochog ire ka tema yor uwal le ila mwo yesa hola yodla yebe yor uwal iyang. Re wochog ire ka yesa tarhagdah yesa mes loh.

Re wochog hatobtob, ka ye palingling, bo mekla wegdigir le ye hamama ila yema llah loh le ye wochog burburol hatobtob. Resa wochog fis kala retema peslag liliyer, le Deus yesa faesul hafle liliyer mo lobola ye ruchupung le tor siyal.
Enoch mele hawoldalel daowe yael Adam. Muswe chog ngo iy yesa kapta kofer we ye sor bo, “Samol yebe budoh le fedngeras angelus kala lol le re santus le rebe dabey doh.

Yebe budoh bo yebe hatugulu kofer panger yarmat. Iwe ngo ye fang yar hagerger panger rechokla reto hamolfid ngo rete hafali Deus. Yebe fang yar hagerger bo fael wegdeg kala ir re foforu, mo hapatpat tayikof kala choto hamolfid rema sor irel Deus luwul yar te hafali loh!”

Rechokla ila pangal yad ngo rema lunglung irel yarmat ngo re yetedah hapatpat uwor yarmat. Rema dabey chog ikla deper le ye tayikof. Ngo rema kapta chog kofer ir lufulyer le rema sor bo ir mele tusurer irel mekla re foforu. Iwe ngo rema limsiy yarmat bo fael mala yebe yoh ngalir mekla ir re luluwaley.
Hamedaf Ngalir Yarmat
Hami rewol maryarey, ha towe maligili mokwe apostel kowe re dabeyel Samol we yach Jesus Kristus re kapta muswe.
Re kangalugmi bo, “Bela hola ral kala hartael loh ral, ngo bele budoh tot yarmat le re bele taplie fedalehmi kamemal, le rechokla rema dabey chog mekla deper, ngo rete hafali loh Deus.”
Ikla rechoka re foru le yarmat rebe harere ngo mekla chog deper le ye tayikof mele ye lamlir, iwe ngo tor kamelal Espritu Santus uwor.
Iwe ngo hami rewol maryarey, ila habe hakela chog tugul la yami le ye holngol santus. Habe ma mepel luwul mala kelel Espritu Santus.
Iwe ngo hasa mel chog irel hachangcheng la yael Deus irel yodla ha wiwidi Samol la yach Jesus Kristus luwul ffahoy la yal bo yebe fang ngalugmi molow la tor siyal.
Hakawraloh yami ffahoy ngalir rechokla yesa yeyewal deper;
Iwe ngo hasa hadorar sibis le habe hachuyar mo lubululyef. Hasa kewar ngalir ikla sibis yami fahol ladep mo yami motog, ngo hasa hafali bo yede pachngalugmi mekla wegdigir mo depel maltemay kala yar.
Mepelel Hapingping
Ngali yeramtala be yoh ngali le yebe itol chog yami tugul le towe pung tangugmi ngo yebe hasugmi loh irel falmay la yal irel lobola habe rraey iyang —

Ngali Deus le iy chog, le iy yach Demer mo irel Jesus Kristus le yach Samol, sibe hapingpinga bo iy mele ye hartael tagiyet, iwe ngo pangal ngo yema yoh irel, ngo ye lamli pangal formel irel molwe chapdagel dah chog, iwe mo igla sa loh le tor siyal! Amen.
